title: Static Long-Bill High-Continuous-Sail Fish
description: One newly authored complete stylised sailfish-like exterior. A very long narrow upper bill grows directly from the tapered angular head of one elongated muscular body, narrowing behind to a slim caudal stock. A single tall broad continuous dorsal sail with rounded leading crown and gradually falling scalloped upper margin spans most of the back; a deep crescent forked tail and two long swept pectoral fins contrast with the narrow body and small lower fins. The whole axial head-bill/body profile, sail and crescent caudal are new, not an old short-headed fish stretched or a lionfish with repeated spines removed. No old visible meshes imported. One model zero scenes. Small finite lowest-belly presentation datum is artistic support, not natural standing or buoyancy. No exact species, anatomy, sail mechanics, swimming, rig, animation, interaction, live animal care or safety claim.
